visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a pair of metal scissors held towards the camera lens, with the brand name 'Scotch' visible on the blade. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a young man with brown hair and a black striped jacket speaking directly to the camera in an indoor room. Behind him is a large painting of a yellow flower and a green plant. (3) A series of colorful 2D animations appear, showing a narwhal character swimming underwater with a white cable, transitioning to graphics of office workers and a group of children smiling. (4) The shot returns to the man in the striped jacket, while another man in a white t-shirt stands behind him, holding scissors near the first man's head as if to cut hair. Book covers and graphic text overlays with book titles appear on the left and right sides of the frame.
